html:
Motion Arcade is a multiplayer cooperative puzzle game designed to solve various challenges and puzzles through teamwork. The game supports up to 5 players to participate at the same time. Each player controls a character through our foot remote controller, and overcomes obstacles in the level through simple operations such as jumping and moving. Different cooperation mechanisms are designed for each level, requiring players to work closely together, such as stacking people and shield guarding, which enhances interaction and fun. Its cartoon-style graphics and simple operations make it suitable for players of all ages, and it is especially popular when families and friends gather together.



>> Features of Motion Arcade:


  • Multiplayer Support

Accommodates single players or groups, allowing seamless turn-taking and dynamic gameplay for parties or casual play.

  • Unlimited Score Recording

Automatically records each round's dart results without limit, letting players track their performance and enjoy extended play.

  • Integrated Camera System

Captures players’ faces when it’s their turn, adding a personalized and fun element to the game experience.

  • User-Friendly Interface

Easy-to-read digital display and intuitive controls enhance accessibility for players of all levels.

  • Versatile Gameplay Modes

Includes classic darts scoring and customizable game formats to keep players engaged.

  • Robust and Durable Design

Built to withstand frequent use in busy social environments.



>> Product Advantages:


Enhances Social Interaction

Ideal for social events, Motion Arcade promotes connection and fun among friends and family.


Encourages Friendly Competition

Real-time scoring and player recognition add motivation and excitement.


Suitable for All Skill Levels

Whether a beginner or a seasoned darts player, everyone can enjoy the game thanks to adaptable settings.

Easy Setup and Maintenance

Designed for hassle-free installation and minimal upkeep, perfect for homes, bars, and entertainment venues.


Engaging Visual and Interactive Experience

The camera and digital scoring system create an immersive and modern twist on a traditional game.



>> Product Applications


  • Home Entertainment: Bring a fun and interactive experience to family game nights or casual gatherings.

  • Bars and Pubs: Attract customers and enhance the social atmosphere with an innovative darts setup.

  • Corporate and Team-Building Events: Use as a fun activity to boost team spirit and camaraderie.

  • Recreation Centers and Clubs: Provide an engaging and competitive option for visitors of all ages.

  • Party and Event Venues: Perfect for birthday parties, celebrations, and social meetups to keep guests entertained.



>> FAQs for Smart Darts:


Q1: How many players can participate at once?

A1: Motion Arcade supports 1 to multiple players, allowing flexible gameplay for individuals or groups.


Q2: Does the system keep track of scores automatically?

A2: Yes, the system records each round’s dart scores unlimitedly, so players can focus on the game without manual scoring.


Q3: What is the purpose of the integrated camera?

A3: The camera captures the current player’s avatar during their turn, adding a fun personalized touch to the game experience.


Q4: Is Motion Arcade suitable for beginners?

A4: Absolutely! The game is designed with user-friendly controls and adjustable settings to accommodate all skill levels.


Q5: Can this product be installed in commercial venues?

A5: Yes, Motion Arcade is robust and easy to maintain, making it ideal for bars, clubs, and other entertainment spaces.
